resolved.description: The boss, set only when the query matched one name in one location. Empty otherwise.

location.description: Where this encounter happens. Part of its identity: the same name in another place is a different fight with different health.

match_count.description: How many distinct boss names matched.

ambiguous.description: True when the query names several bosses, or one boss fought in several places.

locations.description: Populated when one name is fought in several places, so the follow-up question is 'which one' rather than 'which boss'. Empty otherwise.

multi_phase.description: True when the fight has more than one set of figures. An answer about such a boss has to be per phase.

phases_labelled.description: Whether the table names the phases. False with more than one phase means the sheet records several entries without saying how they relate.

phases.description: Every phase of the fight, in fight order, each with its own figures. There is deliberately no boss-level defence or negation: for a multi-phase fight there is no such number.

label.description: What the table calls this phase, e.g. 'Phase 1'. Empty when the fight has one set of figures, or when the table does not name them.

defence.description: Flat per-type defence for this phase. Feed to optimal-affinity's `defense`.

negation.description: Per-type negation as a percentage, for optimal-affinity's `negation`. Negative means this phase takes MORE of that type.

resist.description: Status resistance. A status this phase is immune to reads 0 and is named in immune_to.

immune_to.description: Statuses that cannot be applied in this phase. Not 'very resistant'.

weak_to.description: Damage types whose negation is negative in this phase.
